svg.title: DTW of mon and sat with window w = 4
svg.desc: Pair mon and sat, window w = 4. Euclidean distance 3.71, DTW distance 0.22. Top: mon (ink) above sat (accent) on one scale, linked along the DTW warping path (every second link is drawn). Bottom: a 48 by 48 grid, rows the samples of mon from the bottom, columns the samples of sat from the left. Only the band of allowed cells is drawn. Higher opacity means higher local cost, the squared difference of the two samples, from 0 to 2.51. The dashed diagonal is lock-step matching and the line through the cells is the warping path.
